meaning:
ἀφεδρών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(cf. ἄφεδρος, Lev.12:5) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word),
a privy, drain: Mat.15:17, Mrk.7:19 (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).†
**ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὀχέω, to carry) [in Sm.: Job.22:24, Psa.65:10 al. ;]
1. a water-pipe, channel.
2. the intestinal canal: Mrk.7:19, WH, mg. (for ἀφεδρών).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?
because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
